notes.title: The next chapter of The Night Fisherman is here!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355430/The_Outcast_Lovers/

Today we launched [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355430/The_Outcast_Lovers/]The Outcast Lovers on Steam[/url]!

After The Night Fisherman struck a chord with us, we thought long and hard about what to do next. The Outcast Lovers is the next chapter in what we hope will be an ongoing short-game series we’re calling The Sacrifices.

[i]Driving home late one night, Ola and Mary encounter an immigrant in distress. He’s looking for salvation, but in near-future Britain he’ll be imprisoned or worse. Do you hand him over, washing your hands of his fate? Do you take him in, at great personal risk and expense?What will you choose?[/i]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1355430/The_Outcast_Lovers/]Play it for free now![/url]

[previewyoutube=ApGWaq2fO6s;full][/previewyoutube]

Stay safe out there,

de Fault

notes.title: Early reviews & pre-launch success
notes.content:
Hello Fishers!

We've had an amazing launch on Itch, recently passing 5,000 downloads, we're currently the most popular non-horror game on Itch, and as a community we've raised a helluva lot of money for Black Lives Matter through various bundles, one of which is [url=https://itch.io/b/513/black-lives-matter-support-bundle]still available[/url] and recently passed 100k!

A lot has happened in the past two weeks, we've been featured in [url=https://kotaku.com/itch-io-s-anti-racism-bundle-gave-me-space-to-reflect-1844007436]Kotaku[/url] and [url=https://www.freegameplanet.com/the-night-fisherman-download-game/]Free Game Planet[/url], we were mentioned in a [url=https://www.pcgamer.com/donate-dollar5-or-more-for-742-games-in-the-bundle-for-racial-justice-and-equality/]PC Gamer[/url] article alongside such high profile games as Night in the Woods and Oxenfree (!)

We have been completely bowled over by all the support you've given us, and the enthusiasm you have for such a simple little game.

Thanks to everyone who's shared our game with a friend, bought the bundle, created a collection or recorded a Youtube video, it is all deeply appreciated and gives us the confidence we need to keep bringing you more playable stories like this.

If you'd like to keep helping us, please leave a rating, drop a comment on the page or share the game with a friend.

So I'm here to say, this is NOT THE END of the story.
We've listened and we will be bringing you MORE [url=https://twitter.com/search?q=%23thenightfisherman]#thenightfisherman[/url] content VERY soon, so keep your eyes peeled!

Good fishing,
Chard
